format: Theme mode conformance vectors. Core (renderer-theme-mode.test.ts) and Rust (theme.rs) run this file. A row is [name, reply, mode, issue?].
reply is an OSC 11 reply as a terminal sends it. mode is the theme mode of its background: "dark" or "light".
A background is light when its brightness (299 R + 587 G + 114 B) / 1000, computed exactly, is above 128.
